ranked_taxonomy.name: Out-of-Scope Safety Leakage / Guessing
ranked_taxonomy.description: LLM attempts to speculate or answer unanswerable out-of-scope queries instead of cleanly abstaining.
ranked_taxonomy.recommended_fix: Add explicit strict abstention system prompt guardrails for out-of-scope domain questions.

ranked_taxonomy.name: Chunk Boundary Context Fragmentation
ranked_taxonomy.description: Multi-condition policy rules span across chunk splits, causing LLM to miss secondary clauses.
ranked_taxonomy.recommended_fix: Increase chunk size from 500 to 750 words with 100 word overlap, or use document section grouping.

ranked_taxonomy.name: Numeric Precision & Unit Truncation
ranked_taxonomy.description: LLM answers with raw numbers missing currency symbols ($), timeline units (business days vs calendar days), or percentage signs.
ranked_taxonomy.recommended_fix: Update generation prompt to enforce strict exact-match quoting of monetary caps and time units.

ranked_taxonomy.name: LLM Over-Abstention / False Negative Refusal
ranked_taxonomy.description: Right document chunk is fetched, but LLM conservatively claims information is not found.
ranked_taxonomy.recommended_fix: Refine LLM system prompt instructions to allow subtle semantic matches without false refusal.

ranked_taxonomy.name: Dense Embedding Keyword / Section Blindspot
ranked_taxonomy.description: Dense vector search misses exact section numbers (e.g. 'Section 3') or technical policy codes.
ranked_taxonomy.recommended_fix: Integrate BM25 lexical search with RRF fusion to capture exact section identifiers.
